strings.d1.theme: The Strip: Bellagio to the Venetian
strings.d1.s0.name: Bellagio Conservatory
strings.d1.s0.tips: Free seasonal flower garden. In the lobby, look up at the Chihuly glass ceiling.
strings.d1.s1.name: Bellagio Fountains
strings.d1.s1.tips: Music-synchronised fountain show every 30 minutes (every 15 in the evening). Free and an icon of the Strip.
strings.d1.s2.name: Bacchanal Buffet Caesars
strings.d1.s2.tips: Vegas's most famous buffet with 250 dishes. Book ahead to skip the queue.
strings.d1.s3.name: Forum Shops Caesars
strings.d1.s3.tips: Roman-themed mall with a painted sky ceiling and the Atlantis show. Air-conditioned.
strings.d1.s4.name: Venetian Grand Canal Gondola
strings.d1.s4.tips: An indoor Venetian canal with a gondolier, plus a replica of St Mark's Square.
strings.d1.b0.name: Eataly Park MGM
strings.d1.b0.tips: Italian food market. An alternative to the buffet.
strings.d1.b1.name: Wynn Lake of Dreams
strings.d1.b1.tips: The Wynn's lake show. Free, in the evening.
strings.d2.s0.name: Sphere Las Vegas Experience
strings.d2.s0.tips: The world's largest LED sphere. See the film Postcard from Earth (~100 USD); the exterior display is free at night.
strings.d2.s1.name: The LINQ High Roller
strings.d2.s1.tips: A 170 m observation wheel. The sunset slot is pricey; the cabins are air-conditioned.
strings.d2.s2.name: Fremont Street Experience
strings.d2.s2.tips: Downtown's covered LED canopy with live music, the Golden Nugget and the SlotZilla zipline (~50 USD).
strings.d2.s3.name: Container Park Downtown
strings.d2.s3.tips: A shopping area built from shipping containers, with a fire-breathing praying mantis sculpture.
strings.d2.s4.name: Evel Pie Fremont
strings.d2.s4.tips: Punk rock pizza joint. Grab a slice and a beer.
strings.d2.b0.name: Carson Kitchen Downtown
strings.d2.b1.name: Mob Museum
strings.d2.b1.tips: The museum of the Mafia. An alternative to Sphere.
strings.d3.s0.name: Red Rock Canyon Scenic Drive
strings.d3.s0.tips: In summer, enter at 07:00 (42°C) and finish by 10:00. Bring 3 litres of water.
strings.d3.s1.name: Calico Tanks Trail
strings.d3.s1.tips: A short summer walk (Calico Hills, 1 km). There is no shade.
strings.d3.s2.name: Red Rock Casino Feast Buffet
strings.d3.s2.tips: A local buffet in Summerlin, cheaper than the Strip.
strings.d3.s3.name: Downtown Summerlin
strings.d3.s4.name: Cosmopolitan Chandelier Bar
strings.d3.s4.tips: A bar inside a three-storey chandelier. Try the Verbena cocktail.
strings.d3.b0.name: Spring Mountain Ranch
strings.d3.b0.tips: A ranch and lake at the foot of the canyon. An alternative to hiking.
strings.d3.b1.name: Lotus of Siam
strings.d3.b1.tips: Vegas's famous Northern Thai restaurant. An alternative to the buffet.
strings.d4.theme: Hoover Dam and Valley of Fire
strings.d4.s0.name: Hoover Dam
strings.d4.s0.tips: 45 minutes from the city. See the 1936 dam, take the Powerplant tour (15 USD) and walk across the Mike O'Callaghan Bridge.
strings.d4.s1.name: Lake Mead Overlook
strings.d4.s1.tips: A viewpoint over the reservoir, where the water level shows a pale "bathtub ring" on the rocks.
strings.d4.s2.name: Boulder City Coffee Cup Cafe
strings.d4.s2.tips: A 1950s-style cafe in the town that built the dam. Good for breakfast or lunch.
strings.d4.s3.name: Valley of Fire State Park
strings.d4.s3.tips: Valley of Fire hits 40°C+ in summer. Do the short Mouse's Tank walk and enjoy the views from the car.
strings.d4.b0.name: Seven Magic Mountains
strings.d4.b0.tips: Colourful stacked stone towers in the desert (Ugo Rondinone), just off the I-15. An alternative to Valley of Fire.
strings.d4.b1.name: Boulder Dam Brewing
strings.d5.s0.name: Arts District Las Vegas
strings.d5.s0.tips: The 18b Arts District has murals, galleries and antique shops. It is cool in the morning.
strings.d5.s1.name: Esther's Kitchen Arts District
strings.d5.s1.tips: Vegas's best-loved Italian restaurant. Make a reservation.
strings.d5.s2.name: Hotel Pool / Dayclub
strings.d5.s2.tips: The real sport of Vegas in summer: a hotel pool or dayclub (Encore Beach Club ~50 USD). At 42°C it is the only remedy.
strings.d5.b0.name: Nacho Daddy Downtown
strings.d5.b0.tips: Nachos and scorpion shots Downtown. An alternative lunch.
strings.d5.b1.name: The Neon Museum
strings.d5.b1.tips: A graveyard of old neon signs. The night tour is cooler.
strings.d6.s0.name: Shark Reef Aquarium Mandalay Bay
strings.d6.s0.tips: A shark tunnel. An air-conditioned morning.
strings.d6.s1.name: AREA15
strings.d6.s1.tips: Omega Mart (Meow Wolf), a surreal supermarket. Indoors and cool.
strings.d6.s2.name: In-N-Out Burger Las Vegas
strings.d6.s2.tips: Behind the LINQ. Order it animal style.
strings.d6.s3.name: Cirque du Soleil O Bellagio
strings.d6.s3.tips: "O", the water-stage show at the Bellagio. Buy tickets online, or try Tix4Tonight (TKTS) for half-price same-day seats.
strings.d6.s4.name: Bellagio Fountains Night
strings.d6.s4.tips: Every 15 minutes at night. Catch it after the show.
strings.d6.b0.name: Absinthe Caesars
strings.d6.b0.tips: An adults-only cabaret in a tent. An alternative to O.
strings.d6.b1.name: Hash House A Go Go
strings.d7.theme: Welcome sign and a gentle farewell
strings.d7.s0.name: Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas Sign
strings.d7.s0.tips: At the southern end of the Strip. No queue in the morning.
strings.d7.s1.name: The Park MGM & T-Mobile Arena
strings.d7.s1.tips: A pedestrian park with the Bliss Dance sculpture.
strings.d7.s2.name: Peppermill Restaurant
strings.d7.s2.tips: A 1972 pink-neon cafe open 24 hours. Giant pancakes make a fitting farewell breakfast.
strings.d7.s3.name: Fashion Show Mall
strings.d7.s3.tips: Last-minute souvenirs. The airport is 15 minutes away.
strings.d7.b0.name: Bouchon Bakery Venetian
strings.d7.b1.name: Aria Fine Art Collection
strings.d7.b1.tips: A free art collection in the hotel. An alternative to the mall.
strings.note0: The Strip is 7 km long. Options: the Deuce bus (8 USD for 24 hours), the monorail, or Uber (10-20 USD). You need a car for Red Rock, Hoover Dam and Valley of Fire.
strings.note1: June to September hits 40-45°C: do desert trips from 07:00 to 10:00, spend the day at pools, malls and museums, and the night on the Strip. Carry water and a hat, and never leave children or pets in the car.
strings.note2: The resort fee (30-50 USD per night) is not included in the hotel price. Buffets cost 60-80 USD and shows 100-150 USD; Tix4Tonight sells at half price.
strings.note3: Drinks in casinos are free while you gamble. Tip 1-2 USD per drink, and 18-20% in restaurants.
strings.note4: Book Sphere and O tickets weeks ahead. Red Rock scenic drive needs a timed reservation (October to May).
strings.note5: Grand Canyon West is 2.5 hours away (Skywalk) and the South Rim 4.5 hours; helicopter tours cost 400+.
